name: @magenais/meta-intelligence
description: MAGENAIS Meta-Intelligence: a thin orchestrator for the Problem -> Understand -> Goals/Constraints -> Known/Unknown/Assumptions/Evidence -> ... -> Adaptation pipeline. Early stage — the nine-stage Definition-of-Done pipeline's representation is now implemented through AWU-10 (action-governance, result-verification, and the retry/re-plan/escalate/accept adaptation decision), with no real execution, composition, re-execution, or automatic retry yet.
